text: Had coffee with Marcus. He's gone fully vegan since the summer and is really missing cheese. He supports Leeds and is going to the away game at Hull next Saturday.
Hemi rang. Her cat Biscuit has to have two teeth out on Thursday and she's quite worried about the anaesthetic. Remind me to text her Thursday evening to see how he got on.
Ahmed doesn't drink at all, so get alcohol-free stuff in for the barbecue.
Ethan's knitting a jumper for his niece. It's his first proper project and he's very proud of the cables.
Nora says she's coeliac, not just avoiding gluten. Worth remembering when we book the restaurant.

Lunch with Anders and his wife Ines. They're moving to Gothenburg sometime in the spring, probably April. Ines is a bit anxious about finding work there, she's a midwife and her Swedish is still basic. Anders has already lined up a job with an engineering firm and starts on 1 May 2027. They're having a leaving do sometime in March. Anders asked for recommendations for Swedish crime novels, he's working his way through all of them.
Pieter Jensen's 40th is on 2 November 2026. He's obsessed with single malt whisky, especially Islay ones. Don't forget to get him a bottle before then.
Dalia cancelled her trip to Lisbon after all, the flights got too expensive. She's doing a pottery course on Tuesday nights instead.
Rin plays the cello in a community orchestra. Their winter concert is on 12 December 2026 and she's terrified about her solo. I should text her good luck that morning.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow and book the car in for its MOT.
Ifeoma's mum is having a hip replacement next Tuesday. Ifeoma is going to stay with her for a week afterwards. Must call her the weekend after.
Uma is really into bouldering at the moment, she goes three times a week. She hates running though.
Chat with Lindiwe after book club. She's reading everything by Ursula Le Guin and wants the new hardback of The Dispossessed for her birthday. Her birthday is sometime in January, I think the 18th.
Aneesh got the job at the bank! He starts in a fortnight. Remind me to send congrats properly.
Sadia and her husband Tunde are having their anniversary dinner on Friday. Their 10th, apparently.
Pooja is allergic to tree nuts, properly allergic, carries an EpiPen. Also doesn't like coriander.
Arturo said his band has a gig at the Fleece next Thursday. He plays bass. They're called Lowland Static. I'm going with Jen.
Remind me to ask Archie how his driving test went. It was this morning and he was really nervous about the roundabouts.
Haruto has started making his own ramen from scratch, takes him two days. He's after a proper stockpot, hint hint.
Ben's wedding is off. He and Isabel split up last weekend. He seemed okay but quieter than usual. I should check in with him next week.
Aiko's grandad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is in Osaka at the end of the month and she's flying out on Wednesday.

Tendai is training for the Cardiff half marathon in March 2027. He's doing long runs every Sunday and has cut out beer completely until then. He's raising money for a mental health charity because of what happened with his cousin. He said the knee is holding up but his calves are wrecked. Remind me to sponsor him this weekend, and I should ask how the twenty mile run goes next Sunday.
Valentina, or Val as she likes to be called now, only drinks oat milk flat whites. Very particular about it.

Francesca's daughter starts nursery after half term. Fran is dreading the drop-offs, says her little one cries whenever she leaves the room. I should text her that first morning to see how it went, and maybe take her for a coffee afterwards. She also mentioned she's given up on her running club for now, which is a shame because she loved it.
Esther collects vintage Pyrex, mostly the patterned ones from the seventies. She found a rare one at a car boot sale yesterday.
Ayo's sister Chioma is graduating in the summer, medicine at Edinburgh. He's so proud of her. I'd like to get her something for it, maybe a nice stethoscope.
Plan for this weekend: sort out the garden, finally fix the shed door, and batch cook for the week.
Marcus and his partner Dalia are hosting a games night next Friday. Marcus is really into Wingspan at the moment, and Dalia prefers co-op games. I'm bringing snacks. Note that Dalia doesn't eat pork.
Spoke to Hemi on the phone. Biscuit is fine after the dental op, eating again. She was so relieved.
Need to ring Ahmed about the Arsenal tickets before Wednesday.
Ethan has a job interview with the council on Monday 9 November 2026. He's not that bothered, says it's just practice. Ask him how it went afterwards.

Long catch-up with Nora over dinner. She's had a rough few months. Her dad was diagnosed with Parkinson's in the summer and she's been going up to Durham most weekends to help her mum. She's thinking about going part time at work after Christmas so she can be there more. She also mentioned she's taken up crochet to stay sane, which I love. I should call her sometime next week and maybe send her a nice crochet pattern book.
Anders is a massive Liverpool fan, watches every match even at 5am when he's travelling.
Pieter said his wife Rin is expecting their second, due in the spring. They haven't picked names yet.
Ifeoma's not drinking caffeine anymore, migraines. Get decaf in before she visits on Saturday.
Uma's band is playing a battle of the bands on 14 November 2026. She's the drummer and she's been practising every night. She's really nervous. Don't forget to message her good luck on the day.
Just had a nice chat at the school gate. Nothing much.
Lindiwe's son Archie got into the county under-14 cricket squad. Lindiwe is thrilled. Archie bowls leg spin, apparently quite well.
Remind me to book a table somewhere vegetarian for Aneesh's leaving drinks. It's sometime in early December, date TBC.

Sadia is learning Japanese for a trip to Tokyo next autumn. She practises on Duolingo every day and is up to a 200 day streak. Her husband Tunde is less keen, he's mostly excited about the food and has a list of ramen shops already. They're going for three weeks, possibly in October 2027 if work allows. Sadia's also really into Studio Ghibli and wants to visit the museum.
Coffee with Pooja and Ines. Pooja's started a sourdough obsession, she's named her starter Gerald. Ines is training for her first triathlon in June 2027 and is a bit overwhelmed by the swimming part.

Arturo's mum's 70th birthday is next Sunday. He's organising a surprise lunch for her at the Italian place on the high street and is stressed about it, mostly because his sister keeps changing the guest list. His mum is diabetic so the dessert needs some thought. Must offer to help with the cake, and I should ring him on Saturday to see if he needs anything else.

Jen says the work Christmas party has been called off this year. Budget cuts. Instead a few of us are doing drinks at hers on Friday 18 December. Jen only drinks gin and has strong opinions about tonic, so I'll bring a nice bottle. Her partner Arturo is cooking, he's doing a Mexican spread because Jen can't stand anything too creamy.
Haruto Sato supports the Yokohama Marinos and gets up at stupid o'clock to stream their games. Also loves anything with yuzu.

Ben was asking about good fly fishing spots in the Lakes. He's going up there sometime next month with his dad, who's just retired after thirty years on the railways. Ben ties his own flies and has a whole tackle box of them. His dad apparently only eats fish he's caught himself, which made me laugh. Worth sending him that list of rivers Archie gave me.
Isabel's dog Pickle has gone missing. She's put posters up everywhere. Remind me to message her tomorrow to see if there's any news.
Aiko is back from Osaka. She said the funeral was lovely but she's exhausted. I'll take her for a quiet lunch on Friday.
Tendai's partner Esther is a pastry chef at a hotel in town. She makes the best canelés. Tendai says she wants a proper stand mixer, they still use a hand whisk.
Valentina has a hospital appointment on the 27th about her knee. She's had the injury since playing netball last year. I should ask how it went.
Dentist moved to next Tuesday at 10. Need to rearrange the Tuesday call.
Francesca's brother Marcus is visiting from Melbourne for Christmas. First time back in five years.

Chioma has a big presentation to the board on Thursday and she's been up every night preparing. She's pretty anxious about it. Text her on Wednesday night to wish her luck, then check how it went on Friday.
Ayo's into vinyl, mostly Afrobeat and highlife. He's after an original Fela Kuti pressing, which could be a nice birthday present at some point.
Tunde's not eating red meat at the moment, doctor's orders after his cholesterol test.
Esther and Tendai are buying their first house! Completion is sometime in January. Remind me to get them a housewarming plant when they're in.
Marcus mentioned his little girl Rosie is having her 5th birthday party this weekend. Unicorn theme. He's doing all the cake himself, which seems ambitious.

Hemi follows the All Blacks religiously and will be at the Twickenham match on 7 November 2026 with her brother Pieter. They've had the tickets for months. She's making a day of it, brunch beforehand at the place by the station, then the match, then dinner. Pieter is gluten free so she's been ringing around restaurants. She also plays touch rugby on Wednesday evenings, which I didn't know.
Note to self: start Christmas shopping sometime soon, before it gets silly.
Ahmed's wife Sadia is starting a pottery course in the new year. He wants to get her a set of decent tools for it.

Caught up with Ethan, Nora and Rin at the pub quiz. Ethan's band is recording an EP in a fortnight, he plays keys. Nora's sister is getting married next summer in Crete and Nora is the maid of honour, already panicking about the speech. Rin mentioned she's gone dairy free and feels loads better. Remind me to ask Ethan how the recording went, and send Nora some speech tips.
